q:
Which of the following will be FIRST sentence.

(A) In many cases the early riser also finds time to take some exercise in the fresh morning air,

(B) In the early morning the mind is fresh, and there are few sounds or other distractions.

(C) It gives good start in our days work and helps us complete a large amount of work before other man have got out of bed.

(D) By beginning so early, all his work being finished in good time, he has a long interval of rest in the evening before the timely hour when he goes to bed.

(E) This exercise supplies him with a fund of energy that will last until the evening.

(F) There are several advantage of early rising.

(G) The work done at that Time is generally well done.
e:
(F)->(C)->(B)->(A)->(E)->(D)

In many cases the early riser also finds time to take some exercise in the fresh morning air,This exercise supplies him with a fund of energy that will last until the evening. By beginning so early, all his work being finished in good time, he has a long interval of rest in the evening before the timely hour when he goes to bed.

C. If there are very few or no dust – particles in the air, condensation is not likely to take place.
D. Water vapour is rising into the atmosphere. 
E. And this is because the water vapour has to have a surface on which to condense.

E. Stalk – cut tobacco is air cured.
